criteria: No behavioral, defensive, trust, safety, hierarchy, answer-selection or task-strategy instruction.
Fluent surface-composition description; one fixed pair of task-substituted strings.
Leading ASCII space; N-L no parentheses; N-F one parenthetical sentence ending .).
Prefer shared sentence words, differing principally in punctuation.
Evaluate primary then backup then revisions in order; select first revision with zero full-message deltas in every scenario and pilot case.
No inference, outcomes, filler, per-case adjustment, or random padding. Human semantic approval remains mandatory.

attempts.NF: (The following {noun} consists of text with words, spaces, numerals, and various marks used in writing.)

attempts.rationale: Predeclared protocol backup, evaluated before revisions.

attempts.rationale: Shared sentence words; ordinary serial comma in N-L offsets parenthetical wrapper in N-F.
